description.value: Opened in 2014 on Richmond Island, Milltown Bar & Grill is the only restaurant in the Lower Mainland with three distinct waterfront patios — one facing the marina and mountains, one overlooking the Fraser River, and one with views of the main YVR runway. The kitchen emphasises house-made and locally sourced Pacific Northwest ingredients that go well beyond standard pub fare. Despite its Richmond address, the venue is only accessible from the Marpole neighbourhood in Vancouver, so cyclists should factor in their approach route.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at milltownbar.com is live and fully functional, confirming the business is open with posted hours, regular events, and consistent contact details. Takeout is explicitly stated on the website ('Food and drinks are available for takeout Tuesday through Sunday'). OSM lists internet_access=wlan but the website never mentions Wi-Fi, so that amenity stays null per the rules; no bike parking, washroom, or water refill evidence appears in either source.
concerns: OSM phone field is empty; phone number 604-269-2348 sourced from website only, so contact_confirmed.phone is null.
Website copy is internally inconsistent: the main body claims 'three unique waterfront patios' while the footer refers to 'two patios'.
Access note: website states the venue is technically in Richmond but only reachable from Marpole in Vancouver — relevant for cyclists planning a route.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible waterfront bar and grill with confirmed hours, events, and contact information — a distinctive destination for cyclists exploring the Fraser River area.

wow_evidence: only restaurant in the Lower Mainland with three distinct waterfront patios; food and drinks available for takeout
